identity.behavior: Given finite directed simple graph with explicit distinct totally ordered vertex identities, return NONE if acyclic. Otherwise return the lexicographically smallest cyclic-rotation-normalized vertex sequence representing any elementary directed cycle. An elementary cycle visits each vertex once; sequence omits repeated terminal start. Self-loop is a length-1 cycle. Directed reversal is never silently identified. Same vertex/edge sets must give exactly the same witness independent of insertion and traversal order; no mutation of input.
identity.arity: (finite ordered vertex set, directed edge pairs)->NONE or nonempty ordered vertex sequence
